name: Marines (Vargr)
description: Marines are members of fighting forces carried onboard starships. They deal with piracy and boarding actions in space, defend starports and bases belonging to the navy, and supplement ground forces.

marine.name: Marine
marine.description: You specialise in boarding actions and capturing enemy vessels.

special_ops.name: Special Ops
special_ops.description: You have been trained for specialist and covert missions.

support.name: Support
support.description: You are an engineer, battlefield medic or other supporting role.

mishaps.1: Severely injured in action. Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.
mishaps.2: You are captured and tortured by an opposing force. Lose SOC −1 and roll END 8+. If you fail, roll on the Injury table.
mishaps.3: Your pack fails to defeat an enemy or corsair band. Lose SOC −1 and gain the opponent as an Enemy.
mishaps.4: A mission goes wrong and you are stranded behind enemy lines. Increase Stealth or Survival by one level but due to the failure you lose SOC −1 and are dismissed from service.
mishaps.5: You oppose your pack leader but fail to win over the rest of the pack. Roll SOC 8+. If you fail, you are ejected from this career. If successful, you stay on this career, gain a Rival and suffer DM-2 to your next Advancement roll.
mishaps.6: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishaps table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: You are captured and tortured by an enemy. You eventually escape and gain END +1 from the ordeal.
events.4: Your time aboard spacecraft has made you proficient in the space environment. Gain one level in Vacc Suit or Athletics (Dexterity).
events.5: You have become an experienced fighter. Gain one level in Gun Combat, Melee or Recon.
events.6: You are given advanced training. Roll EDU 8+ to gain any skill you are eligible for in this career.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Vargr Life Events table.
events.8: You save the life of a pack member. Gain an Ally.
events.9: You are assigned to a black ops mission. Gain Tactics 1 and DM+2 to your next Advancement roll.
events.10: Your leader is killed and you attempt to take command of the unit. Roll SOC 8+. If you succeed, you become the pack leader and gain DM+2 to your next Advancement roll.
events.11: Your skill and performance in battle earns much respect from your leader. Gain DM+4 to your next Advancement roll.
events.12: You perform a heroic deed in battle. You are automatically promoted and gain SOC +1.
